imagesThatArenTEmbedded: Images that aren’t embedded or linked (left out)
linesWithALooseEnd: Lines with a loose end that has no position (left out)
handPlacedBendsOfLines: Hand-placed bends of lines (drawn as straight or curved lines)
bendsOfCurvedOrMulti: Bends of curved or multi-point arrows (drawn as curves)
freehandStrokesWithFewerThan: Freehand strokes with fewer than two points (left out)
imagesWhosePictureIsnT: Images whose picture isn’t in the file (left out)
picturesInFormatsFreeroDoesn: Pictures in formats Freero doesn’t show (left out)
lineEndsDrawnAsThe: Line ends drawn as the nearest Freero end
picturesInFormatsFreeroDoesn2: Pictures in formats Freero doesn’t show, such as EMF (left out)
videosAndSoundsPlacedAs: Videos and sounds (placed as their poster picture)
videosAndSoundsPlacedAs2: Videos and sounds (placed as a labelled box)
embeddedObjectsPlacedAsA: Embedded objects (placed as a labelled box)
otherObjectsPlacedAsA: Other objects (placed as a labelled box)
imagesThatCouldnTBe: Images that couldn’t be stored (left out)
importedNItemsFromSource: {n, plural, one {Imported {n} item from {source}{value}} other {Imported {n} items from {source}{value}}}
importDrawIoExcalidrawVisio: Import draw.io, Excalidraw, Visio or PowerPoint file…
restoreBoardBackupsFromYour: Restore board backups from your dashboard (Restore backup).
nameIsLargerThanFreero: {name} is larger than Freero reads as a diagram.
everythingInTheFileHas: Everything in the file has a Freero counterpart.
shapesTextConnectorsFramesFreehand: Shapes, text, connectors, frames, freehand and images from a draw.io (.drawio), Excalidraw (.excalidraw) or Visio (.vsdx, also Lucidchart’s Visio export) file, or a PowerPoint deck (.pptx) as slides with their speaker notes. One undo takes it all back.
youCanAlsoDropThe: You can also drop the file on the board, or paste a diagram copied from draw.io or Excalidraw.
